title: GMI Paired Functional Screening Analysis
description: Python analysis workflow for paired ex vivo functional screening under PBS and GMI-modulated conditions. Version 1.1.0 adds independent validation using active and heat-inactivated GMI, reverse-audited quality control, 175-compound reproducibility analysis, ΔMin and ΔAUC sensitivity analyses, and final validation figure/source-data generation.
